notes.title: The new Chapter 1 demo is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[h1]TVI has a new demo! Watch the trailer here:[/h1][h3][/h3][previewyoutube="9WD1G0BxFbU;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]One month to go!![/h3][p]The Victor Initiative releases in roughly one month, so to celebrate I've created a new demo version of the game which properly shows it off! notes.title: A new demo is coming!
notes.notes:
[p]I've realised that TVI's previous demo was coming up on 7 months old at the time of writing, and a lot's changed since then! In the next few days I'm hoping to get a new demo out that more accurately reflects the current state of the game! In the meantime, I've disabled the previous demo as in my eyes it doesn't reach the quality bar I'm now setting for the game. You can still play the VERY FIRST demo on itch, but be warned that it is INCREDIBLY under-baked!

See you in a few days!
Spacepiano :D[/p]

notes.title: Sam Lake joins the Initiative!
notes.notes:
[h2]I'm incredibly excited to announce that Sam Lake will have a cameo appearance in The Victor Initiative![/h2][p]For those not in the know, Sam Lake is the creator of the stories of Max Payne 1&2, Alan Wake 1&2, Quantum Break and Control! You might also know him as the face of Max Payne in Max Payne 1, or the face of Alex Casey in Alan Wake 2![/p][p]
This is an incredible milestone for the game, and I'll have further cast announcements down the line with even more surprises in store! Watch the trailer below for more info, and keep your eyes peeled for a release date soon![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="rATaBQcargw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]See you on the other side!
Spacepiano ;D[/p]

notes.title: The Victor Initiative: Chapter 1 Demo has been updated!
notes.notes:
In celebration of The Victor Initiative participating in the Steam Next Fest later today (or right now depending on when you're reading this!), the demo is receiving a major update.

This update revamps environments, adds new lore entries, a collectibles screen and more! I won't give too much away, if you're curious you can check it out right now!

To celebrate the new demo, Solomon, an amazing friend of mine and the lead character artist on both this project and Voidside, has made a new piece of art as featured below! If you want to check out more of his work, his tag is @adeptisdog over on instagram.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45263797/9326894c52df87a6a076100d347a9160e7553bfa.png[/img]

Thank you all so much for all the support I've received for this project so far, it's been amazing to see people playing the demo and I hope that this demo update gives you some more content before the full release later this year! (More info on that coming soon...)

I hope you have fun!
Spacepiano :D
